body_text:
For an action of $G$ on $X$, the orbit of $x$ is
$G\cdot x=\{g\cdot x:g\in G\}$, and the stabilizer is
$G_x=\{g\in G:g\cdot x=x\}$. Orbits partition $X$; stabilizers
are subgroups of $G$. The kernel of the action is the
intersection of all stabilizers, and the action is faithful
exactly when this kernel is trivial.
